result.evidence_A: About 175 words, roughly 30% over target. Uses an informal second-person 'you' voice unsuited to an abstract. Calls the Italian-Dutch alternation a result of the first OT; the body says ESO suggested it. Omits the GRB970111 non-detection, red afterglows and LP activation outcomes. Its five-node rotation is outdated; a sixth node joined.
result.evidence_B: About 140 words, close to target. Formal and well structured. Covers the GRB970111 non-detection, GRB970228, SN1998bw, polarization, redshifts, z=4.5, red afterglows, and nine activations giving 3 OTs, 1 unconfirmed object and 5 nulls. Notes host-galaxy spectrophotometry. Minor issue: the six-node consortium existed from December 2000, not at the LP's start.
result.comparative_reason: B is more accurate and complete, keeps the GRB000830 caveat, and meets the length target. A is overlong, informal and omits key findings. B has one minor timing slip, but A has more and larger defects.
